title: CPM Demodulator Baseband
text: Demodulate signal using CPM method and Viterbi algorithm, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {M-ary number} sets the modulation order, {Output type} Determines whether output consists of integers or groups of bits, {Symbol set ordering} sets the bit mapping, {Modulation index}, {Frequency pulse shape} sets the type of pulse, {Main lobe pulse duration (symbol intervals)} sets the main lobe duration, {Rolloff}, {BT product} sets the product of bandwidth and symbol time of Gaussian, {Pulse length (symbol intervals)} sets the length of frequency pulse shape, {Symbol prehistory} sets the data symbols used before the start, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the initial phase offset, {Samples per symbol} sets the symbol sampling rate, {Rate options} sets the block processing rate Enforce single-rate and {Traceback depth}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output type
params.values: Determines whether output consists of integers or groups of bits Integer (default) | Bit

params.name: Modulation index
params.values: Modulation index { h i } 0.5 (default) | nonnegative scalar | column vector

params.name: Frequency pulse shape
params.values: Type of pulse shaping Rectangular (default) | Raised Cosine | Spectral Raised Cosine | Gaussian | Tamed FM

params.name: Rolloff
params.values: Rolloff factor of spectral raised cosine pulse shape 0.2 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: BT product
params.values: Product of bandwidth and symbol time of Gaussian pulse 0.3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Pulse length (symbol intervals)
params.values: Length of frequency pulse shape 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Symbol prehistory
params.values: Data symbols used before the start of simulation 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Block processing rate Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Traceback depth
params.values: Traceback depth for Viterbi algorithm 16 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | boolean | int8 | int16 | int32
